description: This file defines API routes for authentication in a FastAPI application, including signup, login, token refresh, logout, and retrieving current user information.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Handles user signup by creating a new user account.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and issues tokens.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes access and refresh tokens using a refresh token.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.
